title: carum triradiatum
intro: Carum triradiatum, commonly known as Bhutika, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Carum triradiatum include its use as an analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant, helping to relieve pain, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, contributing to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
